command:
# Stage the recorded G3 cohort (results/cohort/PRJNA398089/runs.tsv, #25) from ENA into the
# in-region bucket, md5-checked: make stage-cohort, run on instances because ENA to the launch
# host runs at about 50-260 KB/s. Ranks FROM..COUNT; with make run ... NODES=n each member stages
# the ranks r with (r - FROM) % n == its AK2_ENGINE_RANK (a single run: all of them). The script
# and the cohort record come from the launch commit. Afterwards, from the launch host: the cohort
# post (scripts/post/stage-cohort.cohort.sh) merges every member's out/staged.tsv into
# results/cohort/PRJNA398089/staged.tsv and checks that every rank in range has both mates; then
# make tag-objects PREFIX=aws-kraken2/data/cohort/ (the instance role cannot tag).
W=$HOME/ak2; mkdir -p "$W"
if [ -n "${AK2_COHORT_ID:-}" ]; then SHA=$(echo "$AK2_COHORT_ID" | cut -d- -f3); else SHA=${AK2_RUN_ID##*-}; fi
COUNT=1000
FROM=11
NN=${AK2_ENGINE_N:-1}; RK=${AK2_ENGINE_RANK:-0}
PAR=6; RANGES=4
fail() { ak2_say "ERROR: $*"; exit 1; }
ak2_phase setup
sudo -n dnf install -y -q git jq tar gzip > "$W/dnf.log" 2>&1 || { tail -20 "$W/dnf.log"; fail "dnf install failed"; }
git clone -q https://github.com/scttfrdmn/aws-kraken2.git "$W/repo" || fail "clone failed"
git -C "$W/repo" checkout -q "$SHA" || fail "checkout $SHA failed"
ak2_say "checkout $SHA; nproc $(nproc); disk $(df -h "$W" | tail -1 | tr -s ' '); slice $RK of $NN, ranks $FROM..$COUNT"
ak2_phase stage
# Streamed into the run log as it goes (a TTL kill loses at most the files in flight).
(cd "$W/repo" && STAGE_PARALLEL=$PAR STAGE_RANGES=$RANGES STAGE_FROM=$FROM STAGE_STRIDE=$NN STAGE_OFFSET=$RK \
  scripts/stage-cohort.sh stage PRJNA398089 "$COUNT") 2>&1 | tee "$W/stage.log"
RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
# Requests, from the log: each fetched file is RANGES ranged GETs to ENA, one aws s3 cp (one
# PutObject at or below 8 MiB, else CreateMultipartUpload + ceil(bytes / 8 MiB) UploadPart +
# CompleteMultipartUpload) and two HeadObject; a file already present is one HeadObject.
B=${AK2_BUCKETS%% *}
read -r NF NPUT NMPU NPART < <(awk '/ staged \(/{n++; b=$4; sub(/\(/,"",b); if (b<=8388608) p++; else {m++; q+=int((b+8388607)/8388608)}} END{print n+0, p+0, m+0, q+0}' "$W/stage.log")
NPRES=$(grep -c ' present (md5' "$W/stage.log")
ak2_req GetObject-ENA "$((NF * RANGES))" ""
ak2_req PutObject "$NPUT" "$B"
ak2_req CreateMultipartUpload "$NMPU" "$B"
ak2_req UploadPart "$NPART" "$B"
ak2_req CompleteMultipartUpload "$NMPU" "$B"
ak2_req HeadObject "$((2 * NF + NPRES))" "$B"
ak2_say "stage-cohort: $NF files fetched and staged, $NPRES present"
ak2_phase push
ak2_push "$W/stage.log" stage.log
[ -s "$W/repo/results/cohort/PRJNA398089/staged.tsv" ] && ak2_push "$W/repo/results/cohort/PRJNA398089/staged.tsv" staged.tsv
ak2_say "stage-cohort rc=$RC"
exit "$RC"
